title: ModuleInstallService
responsibility: Install one capability foundation without replacing existing project source or invoking providers.

inputs.name: ModuleInstallService.add.root
inputs.description: Project root passed to module-catalog loading, module-tree lookup, package/group planning, and file writing. This method passes the string through without normalizing it.

inputs.name: ModuleInstallService.add.id
inputs.description: Module ID compared with catalog definition IDs using strict equality and interpolated into the generated module README path. If no catalog entry matches, this method throws an Error naming the unknown ID; it does not normalize the string before matching.

outputs.name: ModuleInstallService.add
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the string array returned by writeModuleFiles for the collected setup, package/group plans, README, and module-state entries. If the installed-entry check succeeds, it resolves to []; otherwise this method leaves the array contents to the writer.

errors.name: Module catalog invalid or module unavailable
errors.description: An Error thrown when the loaded catalog has gaps, with their messages joined by newlines, or when no entry matches the requested ID, with an Unknown module message. Failures from awaited catalog, state, planning, or writing calls also reject this promise and are not caught here.
